answer: Sybil farms spin disposable raters before bonds mature. Mechanism: joiners climb a terrace of three staged deposits — 0.8 then 1.5 then 3.2 POA — each stage unlocked only after a pearl commit hashes a unique funding path and a comet-tagged peer seal from a wallet older than 2 epochs. Cost: locked capital across stages plus 0.05 POA if a seal arrives late. Peers recompute pearl path hashes from public join tips. Failure: if two comet seals share a funding root within 12h, slash stage-2 and freeze stage-3 so clone ladders cannot skip the terrace.
